verdict.rationale: Bento documents that every prompt change is versioned, diffable and reversible, and that fixes ship in shadow mode before graduating to full traffic. Nothing shows a developer editing and deploying their own prompts to production without a code release, and skills and rules are said to live in the repo as Markdown and YAML, which implies shipping through code. Missing for 10: documented prompt-registry editing and publishing outside the codebase, runtime prompt fetching or deploy labels for application prompts, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: Every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
